newsitem.title: USA: D.I.Y.Home sees strategic costs continuing.
newsitem.headline: D.I.Y.Home sees strategic costs continuing.

text.p: D.I.Y. Home Warehouse Inc said Friday it expects to continue to incur costs associated with the development and implementation of a strategic plan during the second half of 1997 and into 1998.

"Our commitment to enhancing margin is paying off as we continue to realize a strong improvement in our gross margins," President and Chief Executive Clifford Reynolds said in a statement. "The company's operating expenses have increased in part due to our investment in the future. We have incurred costs relative to our information systems which are already beginning to pay off."
The company did not say what the level of development costs would be during the remainder of the year and into 1998.
D.I.Y. operates 16 warehouse-style home centers in northeastern Ohio, selling products for do-it-yourself home repair and remodeling.
